scope: Current integrated harness on all 25 existing small internal TypeScript/TSX/CSS/Prisma tasks; not a replication of the historical external 18-task campaign.
frozen: Compiled runtime/prompt sources, tool schema, driver, task instructions/order, core, lockfile, SDK including repository patch, model/provider identifiers, effort, worker/toolchain and configured budgets are recorded with hashes.
uncontrolled: No provider weight snapshot or deterministic seed supplied; configured model alias is pinned, underlying served revision not certified.
Provider latency, hidden retries and shared cache are uncontrolled; cyclic/reversed ordering balances exposure but does not isolate cache causes.
Fresh trial roots differ and expose arm/condition labels; prompt construction is frozen, absolute paths are trial-specific.
Supervising source/input audit is independent from task-agent execution but unblinded; negative and ambiguous criteria remain visible.
Command budgets use existing configured defaults: Light120s, integrated native30s/wrapper60s. Commands in audited trials are inspected for actual timeout effects.
SDK estimated tariff and reported usage are not invoice reconciliation; incomplete final streams and cache/request records remain missing.
causalLimit: H3 ordinary-path schema/prompt construction is unchanged. Without recovery activation, ordinary quality/resource differences cannot be attributed to the recovery code. The outage panel identifies its conditional mechanism; ordinary Light/native comparison assesses the complete integrated harnesses.
